question: Why should an input's visible field label remain present while the user enters a value?
options: It preserves the field's purpose for memory support and accessibility throughout entry
Visible labels make every form slower
A field name is needed only before focus
Persistent labels prevent all validation errors
explanation: A persistent, programmatically associated label keeps the control's purpose available during entry and supports users of assistive technology.
subject: User Interface and User Experience Design
topic: Responsive content and inclusive product decisions
objective: UX-076-R1: Apply persistent and programmatically associated form labels

provenance.answerEvidence: W3C WAI form guidance requires visible labels associated with controls so purpose remains understandable. Authoritative verification: https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/forms/labels/

distractorReview.note: Kiro AI verified that only the keyed option preserves visible context and programmatic accessibility during data entry.
